analysis: The test invokes 'docker compose up' as part of publishing a Docker Compose environment, then asserts on printed dashboard/service endpoint output. When 'docker compose up' fails (e.g. due to port contention or container runtime issues on the shared CI runner), the output collection is empty and the Assert.Contains() call fails. This is a previously observed recurring failure pattern for this exact test and is unrelated to the PR's changes (NuGet config, build scripts, docs).
